title: Applications/Solution Architect
description:
Application Architect

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in the Coppell, TX area looking to add an Application Architect to their team. This role combines practical development responsibilities with strategic solution architecture, focusing primarily on hands-on application design, development, and delivery, while providing guidance on broader solution architecture.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead design, development, and delivery of highly available, scalable, and maintainable applications across web, mobile, and emerging technologies.
  • Serve as a hands-on full-stack C# developer using Microsoft technologies including .Net Core, .Net Framework, Web API, ASP.Net, MVC, and related frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain clean, testable, and high-quality code; create unit tests and enforce coding best practices.
  • Create and present technical roadmaps and solution designs to stakeholders and development teams.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure solutions meet business requirements while maintaining a security-first mindset.
  • Mentor and lead team members, promoting a culture of continuous improvement and a "get things done” attitude.
  • Evaluate new technologies and frameworks, making recommendations to improve system performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Apply Solution Architect principles to design end-to-end systems, integrating across multiple platforms and services, while remaining actively involved in development.
  • Work in Agile environments, utilizing DevOps practices and cloud-based platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure) for CI/CD and deployments.

Qualifications:

  • 8-10 years of software development experience with hands-on technical leadership.
  • 2+ years of experience developing technical roadmaps and presenting architectural solutions.
  • Strong experience with full-stack C# development, Web API, and front-end frameworks (e.g., Vue.js or other JavaScript frameworks).
  • Deep relational database expertise (SQL Server), including writing queries, stored procedures, DDL, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with web services, SOA, ETL, XML/XSL, and both relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with creativity, initiative, and customer focus.
  • Experience leading teams to deliver complex, scalable, and highly available solutions.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and influence skills.
  • Security-first mindset and understanding of best practices for protecting sensitive data.
  • Experience with Octopus Deploy, PowerShell, and emerging front-end technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native development, particularly on Microsoft Azure including GitHub Enterprise and GitActions.
  • Knowledge of software design patterns, microservices architecture, and modern DevOps practices.

title: Senior Director of Business Technology
description:
Senior Director of Business Technology

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in Littleton, CO, looking to add a Senior Director of Business Technology to their team. The role is a full-time leadership position with remote flexibility and quarterly on-site collaboration weeks. This opportunity supports our partner in the IT systems integration industry, a leading organization serving both commercial and government clients through enterprise IT, cybersecurity, and business transformation initiatives.
Responsibilities
  • Strategic Leadership & Vision – Shape and execute the organization's business technology vision, aligning internal systems, tools, and applications with strategic business goals.
  • Technology Strategy & Roadmap – Develop and communicate a clear technology roadmap that leverages innovation, enhances scalability, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with executive leadership, operations, and cross-department stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technology solutions that improve efficiency and decision-making.
  • Systems Architecture & Integration – Oversee design, implementation, and integration of business application architecture (ERP, CRM, and analytics tools) ensuring seamless connectivity across platforms.
  • Emerging Technology & Innovation – Monitor industry trends and assess new technologies for adoption potential, balancing innovation with ROI and business risk.
  • Data Management & Insights – Collect, analyze, and report on operational performance metrics (KPIs), using data to guide strategic decisions and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Process Optimization – Identify inefficiencies and collaborate with teams to redesign workflows that increase operational performance and customer satisfaction.
  • Change Management & Governance – Lead structured change management initiatives, including risk assessments, communication plans, stakeholder alignment, and post-implementation measurement.
  • Vendor & Partner Relations – Establish and maintain strong partnerships with technology vendors and industry experts to enhance innovation capabilities and ensure value from strategic alliances.
  • Project Oversight – Support or lead key operations improvement and system implementation projects, ensuring delivery within defined scope, time, and budget.
  • Continuous Improvement – Champion Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma methodologies to embed a culture of ongoing improvement and operational excellence.
  • Team Enablement – Mentor and train end-users and team members on new processes and systems to ensure adoption and sustained performance.
  • Quarterly Collaboration – Participate in quarterly in-office sessions for roadmap planning, performance review, and alignment across teams.
Qualifications
Required:
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in business technology, enterprise systems, or IT leadership roles.
  • Proven expertise in ERP systems, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Power BI, and integration via APIs / DataVerse.
  • Demonstrated success in designing and managing business system architectures that support growth and efficiency.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities.
  • Excellent working knowledge of operating systems, data integration, and automation frameworks.
  • Outstanding communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management abilities.
  • U.S. citizenship required; must be eligible for security clearance.
Preferred:
  • Experience in federal, defense, or government-regulated environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power BI analytics dashboards.
  • Familiarity with change management best practices, risk mitigation strategies, and business process automation.
  • Certifications in Dynamics, Power Platform, or related enterprise technologies.
  • Experience leading distributed or hybrid teams.
Compensation & Benefits
  • Base Salary: $170,000 – $190,000 (commensurate with experience).
  • Comprehensive healthcare, dental, vision, and wellness programs.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid Time Off and 12 paid holidays.
  • Flexible work hours and remote flexibility (with quarterly on-site collaboration).
  • On-site amenities including a fitness facility and modern workspace.
  • Professional development support, ongoing training, and leadership growth opportunities.

title: Assistant Electrical PM
description:
Assistant Electrical Project Manager – Waddell, AZ

GavinHeath is partnering with Loenbro, a leader in electrical contracting for mission-critical data centers, to add an Assistant Electrical Project Manager to their team in Waddell, AZ. This is a full-time, on-site position with opportunities for career growth into senior leadership roles.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the Senior Electrical PM in managing large-scale hyperscale and colocation data center construction projects.
  • Assist with project scheduling, budgeting, and coordination of field teams to maintain construction timelines.
  • Manage RFIs, submittals, and change orders, ensuring documentation is accurate and up to date.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail in construction documentation and project execution.
  • Preferred: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or Construction Management.
  • Preferred: Bilingual (Spanish) for site coordination and subcontractor communication.

title: HR Generalist
description:
HR Generalist

GavinHeath is partnering with a client in Centennial, CO looking to add a HR Generalist to their team. The role is a Direct Hire position. The HR Generalist is responsible for leading and executing a wide range of HR functions to support the organization's strategic goals. This position oversees employee relations, benefits administration, payroll coordination, recruitment, training and development, compliance, and records management. The role works closely with department managers and external vendors to ensure HR processes are efficient, compliant, and aligned with company values and objectives.

Responsibilities:

Benefits & Payroll Administration

  • Manage all aspects of employee benefits programs, including plan design, implementation, renewals, and vendor coordination.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws (ERISA, HIPAA, COBRA, ACA) and manage reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate with third-party payroll processing firm to ensure timely and accurate payroll processing.
  • Approve all employee communications issued by payroll vendors.
  • Oversee the processing of enrollments, terminations, COBRA, changes, rollovers, QDROs, and other benefit-related transactions.

HR Compliance & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate and confidential employee records, including personnel files, performance reviews, benefit enrollment, and payroll changes.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local labor laws and reporting requirements.
  • Prepare documentation and reports required by agencies such as the IRS, DOL, and insurance regulators.
  • Track and process employee terminations, leaves of absence, and other employment status changes.

Recruitment & Onboarding

  • Assist with recruiting: job posting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding.
  • Administer pre-employment screening and ensure smooth new hire integration.
  • Maintain updated job descriptions and organizational charts.

Employee Relations & Performance Management

  • Address and resolve employee relations issues; provide coaching and guidance to managers on mediation and conflict resolution.
  • Conduct exit interviews and analyze feedback to improve retention and workplace culture.
  • Assist in performance management processes including evaluations, coaching, and disciplinary actions.
  • Training & Development
  • Develop and facilitate training programs on interpersonal communication, supervisory skills, compliance, and career development.
  • Support employee growth through structured career planning and development initiatives.

Strategic HR Support

  • Analyze trends in benefits, turnover, and employee satisfaction to recommend improvements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving measures related to HR operations and benefits programs.
  • Collaborate with leadership to align HR strategies with company goals and culture.
  • Communications & Employee Engagement
  • Create and distribute internal HR communications on policies, benefits, events, and other company updates.
  • Organize and promote employee engagement activities and wellness initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related experience required.
  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in a generalist level role strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices.
  • Experience with benefits administration and payroll coordination (experience with third-party vendors a plus).
  • Experience in multi-state environment
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Proficiency with HRIS and payroll systems; MS Office Suite required.
  • HRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.

Competencies:

  • Customer Service
  • Critical Thinking
  • Balanced Decision Making
  • Foster Teamwork
  • Strong written and oral Communication Skills
  • Innovative
  • Business Acumen
  • Detail Oriented
  • Problems should be addressed with possible resolutions to the issues
  • Be able to lead without formal authority
  • Positive attitude and proactive approach
